gloss: to respond to; to live up to; to answer (expectations)

definitions.gloss: to respond to; to live up to; to meet
definitions.explanation: To satisfy or fulfill expectations, demands, or requests.

examples.japanese: {要望|ようぼう}に{応|こた}えて{新|あたら}しい{商品|しょうひん}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: We created a new product in response to demand.

examples.japanese: ファンの{声援|せいえん}に{応|こた}えて{手|て}を{振|ふ}った。
examples.english: I waved in response to the fans' cheers.

notes:
{応|こた}える means to respond to or live up to something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
- Pattern: Xに{応|こた}える (respond to X)

DISTINCTION FROM {答|こた}える:
- {応|こた}える: respond to (expectations, requests)
- {答|こた}える: answer (questions, quizzes)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {期待|きたい}に{応|こた}える: meet expectations
- {要望|ようぼう}に{応|こた}える: respond to requests
- {要求|ようきゅう}に{応|こた}える: meet demands
- {声援|せいえん}に{応|こた}える: respond to cheers
- {信頼|しんらい}に{応|こた}える: live up to trust

ASPECT (ている):
- {応|こた}えている: is responding/meeting

RELATED:
- {答|こた}える: to answer (a question)
- {対応|たいおう}する: to deal with, handle
- {満|み}たす: to satisfy, fulfill
